title: An irreducible polynomial over a domain has geometrically irreducible fibres over a dense open
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a polynomial in several variables which is irreducible over a domain is, after restricting to a dense open of the base, geometrically irreducible in the fibres. The proof reduces to a statement about the polynomial ring over the fraction field and then uses that irreducibility is preserved when passing to a suitable localisation, exhibiting the open on which the geometric fibre stays irreducible. The reduction from the ring statement to the geometric statement about fibres is what makes the argument more than a triviality, but every step is a standard commutative-algebra manipulation. Retained author proof at lines 7502-7554.
